mainTopic: Which service was changed in each disqualified bird-offering case (מליקה, הזאה or מיצוי), and the new משנה on טומאה and מעילה for these birds.
overview: The משנה listed bird offerings that become פסול when one kind is done the way of another. The גמרא asks what exactly was changed in each case: the מליקה (pinching) or the blood service. For a חטאת העוף done like an עולה, it first tries the pinching, then suggests the sprinkling and tries to prove it from the סיפא, but that proof is pushed away. For an עולת העוף done like a חטאת, pinching would clash with רבי יהושע, so the change must be in the מיצוי (squeezing out the blood). In the last clause, where רבי אליעזר and רבי יהושע argue, it must be pinching. So the גמרא accepts that the first and last clauses are about pinching while the middle clause is about squeezing. Then a new משנה teaches that all these birds are not טמא in the throat and have מעילה, except a חטאת העוף done properly. It records the מחלוקת between רבי אליעזר and רבי יהושע about an עולת העוף done fully as a חטאת, including רבי אליעזר's קל וחומר and רבי יהושע's rejection of it.

steps.title: What did the כהן change?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks which part of the service was done differently when the חטאת העוף was offered 'the way of an עולה'.
steps.simpleTranslation: גמרא: In what way did he change it?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא opens by asking a clarifying question about the משנה. It is setting up the discussion that follows.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A bird חטאת and a bird עולה are handled differently in more than one way. They differ in the pinching (מליקה) and in how the blood is applied. The גמרא wants to know which difference the משנה means.

keyTerms.meaning: The discussion that explains the משנה
In what did he change it?
A bird sin offering

phrases.english: Gemara:
In what did he change it?
phrases.notes: This refers to the משנה's case of a bird חטאת done 'the way of an עולה'.

steps.sheelahInformationSought: Which part of the service was done the way of an עולה: the מליקה or the הזאה?

steps.title: If it was the pinching, the משנה would contradict רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון
steps.stepSummary: Suppose the change was in the מליקה. Then the משנה would not match רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון, who heard that the head is fully separated even for a חטאת העוף.
steps.simpleTranslation: If you say he changed the pinching, should we then say the משנה does not follow רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון? He said: I heard that they separate the head even for a bird sin offering.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא tries the first possible answer, that the change was in the pinching. It then points out a problem with that answer.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For an עולה the head is fully cut off. For a חטאת it is normally left attached. רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון says even a חטאת העוף may have its head cut off. So fully cutting off the head could not make it פסולה according to him, and the משנה would disagree with him.

keyTerms.meaning: If you say
Pinching the bird's neck with the fingernail
Shall we say?
They separate the head completely

phrases.english: If you say that he changed the pinching,
phrases.notes: He means he pinched it like an עולה, cutting the head all the way off.

phrases.aramaic: נֵימָא דְּלָא כְּרַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר בְּרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן,
phrases.english: shall we say it is not like Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Shimon,
who said: I heard
that they separate the head even in a bird sin offering?

steps.triggerLanguage: אִילֵימָא דְּשַׁנִּי בִּמְלִיקָה נֵימָא דְּלָא כְּרַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר בְּרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Tests the first possible answer to the question.
steps.kashyaTarget: The reading that the change was in the מליקה
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If cutting off the head disqualifies the offering, the משנה disagrees with רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון, who allows it.

steps.title: So what? We already said the earlier משנה does not follow him
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that this is no real problem, since we already said that the משנה about pinching does not follow רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון.
steps.simpleTranslation: But haven't we already explained that the משנה does not follow רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון?!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes back and says the problem is not serious. We already know these משניות disagree with רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Saying a משנה doesn't follow one תנא is not shocking if we have already said it about a related משנה. So the pinching reading could still work.

keyTerms.meaning: We explained (we set the משנה as following a certain view)

phrases.english: But haven't we already explained
phrases.notes: This points back to the משנה about pinching in the previous chapter.

phrases.english: that it is not like Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Shimon?!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Defends the pinching reading against the problem raised in step 2.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Accepts the conclusion: the משנה really does not follow רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון
steps.terutzHavaAmina: It would be a problem for the משנה to disagree with רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון.
steps.terutzMaskana: This was already said before, so it is not a problem.

steps.title: Another answer: the change was in the sprinkling
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא gives a different answer: the כהן changed the הזאה, the way the blood is put on the altar, and not the pinching.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא offers another explanation of the משנה. The change was in how the blood was applied.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the change was in the sprinkling, the משנה fits even רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון. His view is only about separating the head. So with this reading we no longer need to say the משנה disagrees with him.

keyTerms.meaning: Sprinkling the blood on the altar
No (introduces another explanation)

phrases.english: No; he changed the sprinkling.
phrases.notes: For a bird חטאת the blood is sprinkled. For a bird עולה it is squeezed out on the altar.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives a second answer to the step 1 question that avoids the problem from step 2.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The change was in the מליקה.
steps.terutzMaskana: The change was in the הזאה, so the משנה can fit everyone.
steps.whyThisMatters: The next steps try to prove this reading. Step 7 rejects that proof, and in the end (step 14) the גמרא reads the רישא as being about pinching after all.

steps.title: Proof from the סיפא: above the line it can only mean the sprinkling
steps.stepSummary: The סיפא says a חטאת העוף done above the red line is פסולה, even if done properly as a חטאת. This cannot be about pinching, because pinching is כשרה anywhere on the altar. So it must be about sprinkling.
steps.simpleTranslation: This makes sense too, because the סיפא teaches: if he did it above the line, in the manner of any of them, it is פסולה, even in the manner of a חטאת for the sake of a חטאת. What was changed? If it was the pinching, didn't the master say that pinching is valid anywhere on the altar? So it must be the sprinkling.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings support for the sprinkling answer from the next clause of the same משנה. It works through the same 'what was changed?' question there.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the סיפא the only problem is location: above the red line. Pinching is כשרה anywhere on the altar, so doing it above the line could not make the offering פסולה. That leaves only the sprinkling as the thing done in the wrong place.

keyTerms.meaning: This also makes sense (introduces support)
The later clause of the משנה
Above the red line on the altar
But didn't the master say?
Rather, isn't it…?

phrases.english: This also makes sense,
since the later clause teaches:
if he did it above, in the manner of any of them, it is disqualified,
phrases.notes: 'Above' means above the red line around the middle of the altar. A bird חטאת belongs below it.

phrases.english: and even in the manner of a sin offering, for the sake of a sin offering.
In what did he change it?
If you say he changed the pinching,
but didn't the master say:
pinching anywhere on the altar is valid!
Rather, isn't it that he changed the sprinkling?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Supports the sprinkling answer from step 4.
steps.raayaObject: That the משנה's change is in the הזאה
steps.raayaSupportSource: The סיפא of the משנה (above the line) together with the rule that מליקה is כשרה anywhere on the altar

steps.title: The רישא is about sprinkling too
steps.stepSummary: Since the סיפא is about sprinkling, the רישא must also be about sprinkling.
steps.simpleTranslation: And since the סיפא is about sprinkling, the רישא is also about sprinkling.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes the proof. It applies what it learned from the סיפא back to the רישא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The two clauses of one משנה are read as talking about the same part of the service. So the רישא's 'the way of an עולה' means the sprinkling was done like an עולה, not the pinching.

keyTerms.meaning: The first clause of the משנה
And since

steps.whatToRemember: At this point the גמרא argues that the משנה's 'done the way of an עולה' refers to the הזאה (sprinkling), so the משנה fits even רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון. Step 7 pushes this proof away, and step 14 reads the רישא as being about the מליקה.

phrases.english: And since the later clause is about sprinkling,
the first clause is also about sprinkling.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the proof begun in step 5.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: Both clauses of the משנה are about a change in the הזאה.

steps.title: The two halves of the משנה can be about different things
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא rejects the proof from the סיפא. The סיפא can be about sprinkling while the רישא is still about pinching.
steps.simpleTranslation: Is that a proof? This case is as it is, and that case is as it is!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes away the proof from Steps 5 and 6. Just because the סיפא is about sprinkling does not mean the רישא must be about sprinkling too.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Step 6 assumed both halves of the משנה must deal with the same service. The גמרא now says each half can stand on its own: the רישא can be about pinching and the סיפא about sprinkling. So the problem from Step 2 comes back: the רישא may still not follow רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון.

keyTerms.meaning: Is that a proof? Are the cases really comparable? (a phrase that rejects a comparison)
This one is as it is, and that one is as it is. Each case stands on its own.

steps.confusionAlert: This step does not prove that the רישא IS about pinching. It only shows that the סיפא does not force the רישא to be about sprinkling.

phrases.english: Are the cases comparable?!
This one is as it is, and that one is as it is!
phrases.notes: He means the רישא can be about pinching and the סיפא about sprinkling. Each half has its own topic.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the conclusion of Step 6 by breaking the link between the רישא and the סיפא.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects only the proof from the סיפא, not the possibility that the רישא is about sprinkling.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The proof assumed both clauses of the משנה must deal with the same service, but each clause can be about a different service.

steps.title: What change disqualifies the bird עולה?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא moves to the next case in the משנה, an עולת העוף brought like a חטאת, and asks which service was changed.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה says: a bird burnt offering done the way of a sin offering is פסולה. In what service did he make the change?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא opens a new topic: the case of the עולת העוף in the משנה. It asks what exactly the כהן did differently. This sets up the next two steps.
steps.deeperAnalysis: An עולת העוף and a חטאת העוף differ in more than one service, both in the pinching and in how the blood is handled. So the גמרא needs to know which of these the משנה means when it says the כהן did it 'like a חטאת'.

keyTerms.meaning: A bird brought as a burnt offering
That he changed (did it differently than he should have)
In what?

phrases.english: A bird burnt offering, etc.
In what did he change?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves on from the חטאת העוף case to the next case in the משנה, the עולת העוף, using the same kind of question.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Which service the כהן changed when he brought an עולת העוף like a חטאת: the pinching or the blood service.

steps.title: If the change was in the pinching, the next משנה would not match רבי יהושע
steps.stepSummary: Suppose the כהן changed the מליקה. The next משנה says one is liable for מעילה with all these birds, but רבי יהושע holds there is no מעילה in this case.
steps.simpleTranslation: If you say he changed the pinching, there is a problem. The next משנה teaches: all of them do not make a person impure in the throat, and one is liable for misusing them. Should we say that does not follow רבי יהושע? Because רבי יהושע said: there is no מעילה!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא tries the first answer, that the change was in the מליקה, and finds a problem with it. With that reading, the next משנה would go against רבי יהושע.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The next משנה says that one is liable for מעילה with all the birds listed in our משנה. But רבי יהושע rules that a bird עולה pinched the way of a חטאת has no מעילה. So if our case were about pinching, that משנה would go against רבי יהושע, and the גמרא does not want to say that.

keyTerms.meaning: Pinching: killing a bird by cutting through the back of its neck with the כהן's fingernail
The later clause; here it means the next משנה
The throat. Some bird meat makes a person impure when it is in his throat while he swallows it.
Misusing הקדש property; one who does this owes a קרבן and a payment

phrases.english: If we say that he changed the pinching,
from the fact that the latter clause teaches:
phrases.notes: Here 'latter clause' means the first line of the next משנה.

phrases.english: All of them do not make one impure in the throat,
and one is liable for misusing them –
shall we say it is not like רבי יהושע?
For if it is like רבי יהושע,
doesn't he say: One is not liable for misuse!
phrases.notes: רבי יהושע says this about a bird עולה that was pinched the way of a חטאת.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Tries the first possible answer to Step 8's question and shows the problem with it.
steps.kashyaTarget: The suggestion that the change in the עולת העוף case was in the מליקה.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: With that reading, the next משנה (liable for מעילה on all of them) would go against רבי יהושע, who says there is no מעילה when a bird עולה is pinched like a חטאת.

steps.title: The change must be in the squeezing of the blood
steps.stepSummary: Instead, the גמרא suggests the כהן changed the מיצוי: he handled the blood like a חטאת instead of squeezing it out like an עולה.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, the change was in the squeezing of the blood?
steps.whatsHappening: Since pinching caused a problem, the גמרא suggests the change was in the blood service, the מיצוי.
steps.deeperAnalysis: An עולת העוף's blood is squeezed out onto the altar wall. Here the כהן sprinkled it the way of a חטאת instead. Since the pinching was done properly, רבי יהושע's ruling of no מעילה does not apply, so the next משנה can follow everyone.

keyTerms.meaning: Squeezing: pressing the bird's body against the altar wall so the blood drains out
But rather (introduces a new suggestion after the first one failed)

steps.whatToRemember: For the bird עולה case, pinching does not work because of רבי יהושע and the next משנה. So the גמרא suggests the change was in the מיצוי, the blood service.

phrases.english: Rather, in the squeezing?
phrases.notes: Meaning: the כהן sprinkled the blood like a חטאת instead of squeezing it out like an עולה.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After the pinching answer failed in Step 9, offers the blood service as the change instead.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The change in the עולת העוף case was in the מיצוי, so there is no clash with רבי יהושע.

steps.title: Looking at the last clause: which service was changed?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the סיפא, where רבי אליעזר and רבי יהושע argue about an עולת העוף done below like a חטאת, and asks which service the כהן changed there.
steps.simpleTranslation: Now look at the last clause: a bird עולה that the כהן offered below the line, the way a חטאת is done and for the sake of a חטאת. רבי אליעזר says one is liable for מעילה with it. רבי יהושע says one is not liable for מעילה with it. In this case, which service did the כהן change?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is setting up its next challenge. It quotes the next case in the משנה and asks which part of the service was done the wrong way.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In step 10 the גמרא said the middle case is about a change in the מיצוי. This case looks almost the same, an עולת העוף done like a חטאת. So the גמרא now has to decide whether this case is also about מיצוי or about מליקה.

keyTerms.meaning: The last clause of a משנה
Below the red line on the מזבח, the place where a חטאת העוף is done
One is liable for מעילה, the sin of using הקדש for personal benefit
With the intent that it be a חטאת
In what did he make the change?

phrases.english: Say the last clause:
A bird burnt offering that one performed below
phrases.notes: Below the red line around the מזבח, where a bird חטאת is done. A bird עולה belongs above it.

phrases.english: like the procedure of a sin offering, for the sake of a sin offering:
Rabbi Eliezer says: one is liable for misuse with it,

phrases.aramaic: רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אוֹמֵר: אֵין מוֹעֲלִין בָּהּ.
phrases.english: Rabbi Yehoshua says: one is not liable for misuse with it.
In what did he make the change?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Tests the answer from step 10 (the middle clause is about מיצוי) against the next clause of the משנה.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Which service, מליקה or מיצוי, was changed in the סיפא where רבי אליעזר and רבי יהושע argue?

steps.title: The last clause cannot be about squeezing
steps.stepSummary: If the סיפא were about the מיצוי, רבי יהושע's ruling of no מעילה would make no sense. He only says that when the מליקה was changed.
steps.simpleTranslation: If you say the change was in the squeezing, that is a problem. We can say רבי יהושע ruled this way when the כהן changed the pinching. But would he say it when only the squeezing was changed?!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא tries the first option, that the סיפא is about squeezing, and shows that it does not work.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יהושע holds the bird turns into a חטאת, so there is no מעילה. That makes sense if the pinching itself was done as a חטאת, since that is the main act that sets the bird's status. Changing only the later squeezing step is not enough to turn the bird into a חטאת.

keyTerms.meaning: If you say (the first option being tested)
Squeezing the bird's blood out onto the wall of the מזבח
Pinching the bird's neck with the כהן's fingernail, the way a bird offering is killed
Did he say? (a pointed question that expects the answer no)

phrases.english: If you say it was in the squeezing,
you can say that Rabbi Yehoshua said this
where he changed the pinching;
but did he say it about the squeezing?!

steps.triggerLanguage: אִילֵּימָא בְּמִיצּוּי, אֵימַר דְּאָמַר רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Tests the first possible answer to step 11's question and rejects it.
steps.kashyaTarget: The idea that the סיפא is about a change in the מיצוי
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: רבי יהושע's ruling of no מעילה only makes sense if the bird's status changed, and only a change in the מליקה could do that.

steps.title: Can the middle clause be different from both ends?
steps.stepSummary: So the סיפא must be about the מליקה. But then the first and last clauses are about pinching while the middle one is about squeezing. Is that possible?
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, it is about the pinching? Then the first clause and the last clause are about pinching, and the middle clause is about squeezing?!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא accepts that the סיפא must be about pinching. Then it challenges how odd that leaves the whole משנה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: After step 7 rejected the proof, the רישא is again read as being about pinching. Step 10 said the middle is about squeezing. Now the סיפא is about pinching too. The גמרא is bothered that the משנה would switch topics in the middle and then switch back.

keyTerms.meaning: Rather (then it must be the other option)
The first clause of a משנה
The middle clause of a משנה

phrases.english: Rather, it is about the pinching?
Then the first clause and the last clause are about pinching,
phrases.notes: The first clause is the bird חטאת done like an עולה. Step 7 left it about pinching.

phrases.english: and the middle clause is about squeezing?!

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאֶלָּא בִּמְלִיקָה? רֵישָׁא וְסֵיפָא בִּמְלִיקָה, וּמְצִיעֲתָא בְּמִיצּוּי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Takes the only option left after step 12 and points out the odd result it leaves.
steps.kashyaTarget: Reading the סיפא as about מליקה while the middle stays about מיצוי
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: It seems unlikely that a משנה would switch from one service to another in its middle clause and then switch back.

steps.title: Yes, the משנה really is split that way
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא accepts the split: the first and last clauses are about pinching, and the middle clause is about squeezing.
steps.simpleTranslation: Yes. The first clause and the last clause are about pinching, and the middle clause is about squeezing.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge by simply accepting it. The משנה really does work that way.
steps.deeperAnalysis: There is no new idea here. The גמרא just says the split is not a real problem. Each clause is read in the way that makes sense for its own case, even if the middle one is about a different service.

keyTerms.meaning: Yes (the גמרא accepts what was asked)
The first and last clauses, read together here as one pair

steps.whatToRemember: The first clause (a bird חטאת done like an עולה) and the last clause (רבי אליעזר and רבי יהושע on מעילה) are both about a change in the מליקה. The middle clause (a bird עולה done like a חטאת) is about a change in the מיצוי.
steps.confusionAlert: Do not assume every clause of a משנה must be about the same service. Here the גמרא openly says the middle clause is about something different.

phrases.english: Yes;
the first clause and the last clause are about pinching,
and the middle clause is about squeezing.

steps.triggerLanguage: אִין; רֵישָׁא וְסֵיפָא בִּמְלִיקָה, וּמְצִיעֲתָא בְּמִיצּוּי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 13 by accepting the split reading.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: A משנה would not switch from one service to another in its middle clause.
steps.terutzMaskana: It can. The first and last clauses are about מליקה, and the middle clause is about מיצוי.

steps.title: The general rule for all the bird offerings, with one exception
steps.stepSummary: The משנה rules that all the bird offerings listed before do not make a person טמא in the throat, and that מעילה applies to them. The exception is a חטאת העוף done properly.
steps.simpleTranslation: משנה: None of these birds make a person impure when he swallows them, and a person who benefits from them is liable for מעילה. The exception is a bird sin offering that was done below the line, the way a חטאת is done, and for the sake of a חטאת.
steps.whatsHappening: A new משנה starts here. It gives two rules for all the bird offerings in the earlier list, and then gives one exception.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Even a bird offering that became פסול was still killed with מליקה. Because of that, it does not have the טומאה of a נבלת עוף, which makes a person טמא when it is in his throat. These birds are still forbidden to the כהנים, so מעילה applies. The only bird that escapes מעילה is a חטאת העוף done completely correctly, because a valid חטאת is permitted for the כהנים to eat.

keyTerms.meaning: The throat, the place of swallowing. A dead kosher bird makes a person טמא when it is there.
One is liable for מעילה, meaning misusing הקדש for personal benefit.
A bird sin offering
Below the red line on the מזבח, which is where a חטאת העוף is done
Following the procedure of a חטאת

phrases.english: MISHNA: And all of them do not make impure
phrases.notes: "All of them" means all the bird offerings listed in the משנה before this one, including the פסול ones.

phrases.english: in the throat (where it is swallowed),
phrases.notes: A dead kosher bird that was never properly killed makes a person טמא when he swallows it. These birds had מליקה, so that does not happen.

except for a bird sin offering
that he did below
following the procedure of a sin offering, for the sake of a sin offering.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new משנה. It gives the rules of טומאה and מעילה for the bird offerings listed earlier.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Every bird offering that had מליקה is not טמא בבית הבליעה, and מעילה applies to it. The exception is a חטאת העוף done properly, which has no מעילה.

steps.title: The argument about a burnt offering done like a sin offering
steps.stepSummary: An עולת העוף was done below, like a חטאת, and for the sake of a חטאת. רבי אליעזר says מעילה applies, and רבי יהושע says it does not.
steps.simpleTranslation: A bird burnt offering was done below the line, the way a חטאת is done, and for the sake of a חטאת. רבי אליעזר says one is liable for מעילה with it. רבי יהושע says one is not liable.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה brings a harder case and records a מחלוקת between two תנאים.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Here everything about the service matched a חטאת: the place, the procedure, and the intention. But the bird itself was really an עולה. רבי אליעזר looks at what the bird really is, an עולה, which is never permitted to the כהנים, so there is מעילה. רבי יהושע treats it like the חטאת it was turned into, so there is no מעילה.

keyTerms.meaning: A bird burnt offering, normally done above the red line
With the intention that it be a חטאת

steps.confusionAlert: Keep the two birds apart. In step 15 the bird really was a חטאת. Here the bird is really an עולה that was treated like a חטאת.

phrases.english: A bird burnt offering that he did below
following the procedure of a sin offering, for the sake of a sin offering:
Rabbi Eliezer says: one is liable for misusing it,

phrases.aramaic: רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אוֹמֵר: אֵין מוֹעֲלִים בָּהּ.
phrases.english: Rabbi Yehoshua says: one is not liable for misusing it.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר: מוֹעֲלִים בָּהּ, רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אוֹמֵר: אֵין מוֹעֲלִים בָּהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Takes the exception from step 15 and asks about a bird that is really an עולה but was treated like a חטאת.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: רבי אליעזר says there is מעילה. רבי יהושע says there is no מעילה.

steps.title: רבי אליעזר's קל וחומר
steps.stepSummary: רבי אליעזר argues as follows. A חטאת normally has no מעילה, yet it does have מעילה once its name was changed. So an עולה, which has מעילה even when done properly, should surely have מעילה once its name was changed.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אליעזר said: Think about a חטאת. When it is done for its own sake, there is no מעילה. Yet when its name is changed, there is מעילה. Now think about an עולה, which has מעילה even when done for its own sake. When its name is changed, isn't it only logical that there should be מעילה?
steps.whatsHappening: רבי אליעזר brings a קל וחומר to prove his position from step 16.
steps.deeperAnalysis: His logic is that changing the name makes things stricter. A changed name turns a חטאת from no מעילה into מעילה. So an עולה, which already starts out with מעילה, certainly keeps its מעילה after a change of name.

keyTerms.meaning: "Now if...", the opening words of a קל וחומר
For its own sake, done with the proper intention
He changed its name, meaning he offered it as a different type of קרבן
"Isn't it logical?", the closing words of a קל וחומר

phrases.aramaic: אָמַר רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר: וּמָה אִם חַטָּאת,
phrases.english: Rabbi Eliezer said: Now if a sin offering,
which has no liability for misuse when done for its own sake,
when he changed its name, one is liable for misusing it;
then a burnt offering, which has liability for misuse even when done for its own sake,
when he changed its name,
is it not logical that one should be liable for misusing it?!

steps.triggerLanguage: וּמָה אִם חַטָּאת, שֶׁאֵין מוֹעֲלִים בָּהּ לִשְׁמָהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: רבי אליעזר supports his ruling from step 16 with a logical proof.
steps.raayaObject: That an עולת העוף done like a חטאת and for the sake of a חטאת has מעילה
steps.raayaSupportSource: A קל וחומר from a חטאת whose name was changed. It has no מעילה when done for its own sake, yet it gets מעילה once its name is changed.

steps.title: רבי יהושע rejects the קל וחומר
steps.stepSummary: רבי יהושע answers that a חטאת changed into an עולה becomes something that has מעילה. An עולה changed into a חטאת becomes something that has no מעילה.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יהושע said to him: No. You can say a חטאת gets מעילה when its name was changed to an עולה, because it was changed into something that has מעילה. But how can you say the same about an עולה whose name was changed to a חטאת, when it was changed into something that has no מעילה?!
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יהושע knocks down רבי אליעזר's קל וחומר by showing a difference between the two cases.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The change of name does not simply make things stricter. It makes the קרבן follow the rules of whatever it was changed into. A חטאת changed into an עולה takes on the עולה's מעילה. An עולה changed into a חטאת takes on the חטאת's lack of מעילה. So the קל וחומר falls apart.

keyTerms.meaning: "No; if you said...", the standard way of rejecting a קל וחומר
"Because in that case...", which points out what makes a case different
"Would you say...?", a challenge question
The prohibition and liability for benefiting from הקדש

steps.whatToRemember: רבי אליעזר thinks a change of name makes things stricter, so there is מעילה. רבי יהושע thinks a change of name makes the קרבן follow its new name, so an עולה done as a חטאת has no מעילה.
steps.whyThisMatters: This explains רבי יהושע's view in the מחלוקת. A bird done fully as a חטאת is treated like a חטאת for מעילה.

phrases.english: Rabbi Yehoshua said to him: No;
if you said so about a sin offering
whose name he changed to that of a burnt offering,
that is because he changed its name
to something that has liability for misuse;
would you say so about a burnt offering
whose name he changed to that of a sin offering,
when he changed its name
to something that has no liability for misuse?!

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר לוֹ רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ: לֹא; אִם אָמַרְתָּ בְּחַטָּאת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects רבי אליעזר's קל וחומר from step 17.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The whole קל וחומר from a חטאת to an עולה
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The two cases are not alike. The חטאת was changed into a קרבן that has מעילה, while the עולה was changed into a קרבן that has no מעילה. So the change of name follows the new name's rules and does not always make things stricter.
